items.deptZh: 美团｜到餐事业部｜商家成长业务
items.titleZh: 商家 AI 产品经理
items.descZh: 业务介绍：强化智能掌柜的 AI 能力与商家基础体验迭代，提升价值感知，驱动付费转化与续费增长，提高商业化变现效率。
items.descEn: Scope: Strengthen AI capabilities of the merchant assistant and iterate core merchant experience to improve value perception, drive paid conversion and renewal, and increase monetization efficiency.

productDetails.infoZh: 美团面向餐饮商家打造的 AI 经营助手。通过对话式交互提供经营分析、评价管理、营销建议等核心能力，帮助商家降低数字化经营门槛，实现降本增效。
productDetails.infoEn: An AI-powered business assistant for Meituan merchants. It provides core capabilities like operational analysis, review management, and marketing suggestions through conversational interaction.

productDetails.infoZh: 针对商家提问门槛高、核心能力发现难等痛点，通过前置展示付费能力、新增动态推荐问及优化交互链路，提升商家主动提问意愿与付费转化。
productDetails.infoEn: A major overhaul of the merchant-AI chat interface, surfacing core premium capabilities and adding dynamic suggested prompts to lower interaction barriers and drive conversions.

bulletsZh: 付费链路重构：将付费购买权限扩展至管理员账号，降低商家对超管账号的付费依赖；同步设计多类账号购买链路与开票规则，解决订单归属、续费判断等数据隔离问题；上线一周付费率+0.24pp；付费门店数+278.45%；收入金额+224.14%。
掌柜会话页改版：针对商家提问门槛高/付费点深的问题，主导会话页改版，前置展示核心付费能力并新增推荐问；设计 AB 实验验证改版：CTR+2.11pp，主动提问商家数+2370，提问转化+4.56pp；上线后三项能力付费门店数+76.67%/+68.57%/+1628.57%。
同行 PK 策略优化：数据分析发现 30%~40% 商家 PK 失败，对未完成 PK 商家做数据探查（榜单32.6%>营销活动17.8%>经营数据10.8%）后重构推荐逻辑为多维度优先级策略，新增推荐标签提高 PK 率；PK 成功率+18.33pp，同行 PK 付费门店数+132.04%。
AI 对话评测系统：参与 AI 评测体系建设，制定覆盖信息准确性、逻辑框架、结构化表达三维度的 -1/0/1/2 四档评分标准与评测集，支撑每周 10000+ 商家真实会话的质量监测；持续迭代评测标准（2.0→3.0），推动模型≤0分 case 率稳定控制在 3% 以内。
bulletsEn: Paid funnel redesign: expanded purchase permission to admin accounts to reduce dependency on super-admin; designed flows and invoicing rules for multiple account types; resolved order attribution and renewal judgment isolation; +0.24pp paid rate in first week; +278.45% paid stores; +224.14% revenue.

Conversation page revamp: addressed high asking threshold and deep paywall; surfaced core paid capabilities and added suggested prompts; A/B validated uplift: +2.11pp CTR, +2370 proactive merchants, +4.56pp question-to-conversion; post-launch paid stores for three capabilities +76.67% / +68.57% / +1628.57%.

Peer PK strategy optimization: analysis found 30%–40% PK failures; investigated unfinished PK drivers (leaderboard 32.6% > campaigns 17.8% > ops data 10.8%); rebuilt recommendation logic with multi-dimensional priority and new tags; +18.33pp PK success rate; +132.04% paid stores from PK.

AI dialogue evaluation: helped build evaluation framework with -1/0/1/2 rubric across accuracy, reasoning, and structure; supported weekly quality monitoring for 10,000+ real merchant conversations; iterated standards (v2.0→v3.0) and kept ≤0-score case rate under 3%.

items.deptZh: 小米｜汽车部｜整车大数据业务
items.descZh: 业务介绍：聚焦整车数据看板分散、取数依赖人工、碰撞分析低效核心痛点，搭建数据门户并通过 AI 驱动数据消费与安全运营提效。
items.descEn: Scope: Built a data portal to solve fragmented dashboards, manual data access, and inefficient crash analysis; improved data consumption and safety operations with AI.

productDetails.infoZh:
**1. 看板整合**

动作：将部门所有看板统一至单一数据平台，按域分类呈现，支持全局搜索与筛选

目标：消除多入口、多口径的查找成本，让数据“找得到、信得过”。

**2. 专题聚合**

动作：可按项目、车型、试验阶段等维度，把跨域看板自由组合为“研发专题”，一站式查看上下文数据。

目标：将分散数据还原为清晰决策场景，缩短从“看数”到“决策”的路径。

**3. 社区化交互**

收藏：一键收藏高频看板，形成个人工作台，快速复访。

点赞：为有价值的分析点赞，靠前展示优质内容，激励高质量产出。

评论：直接在数据波动节点下评论，关联上下文，实现数据对话。

目标：让数据可沉淀、可讨论，将个人洞察转化为团队知识，加速问题收敛。

**【核心业务目标】**

促进数据消费：降低使用门槛，培养主动看数、用数的习惯，提升数据活跃度。

提升研发决策效率：通过快速发现异常、聚合证据、形成共识，减少跨团队沟通摩擦与决策延迟。

**平台包含重要数据，我们对演示画面做了适当模糊处理，敬请谅解。*
productDetails.infoEn: Xiaomi Auto's core internal data platform. It integrates multi-dimensional data from production, testing, and safety, providing automated reports and AI-driven data insights. Note: Due to company confidentiality, product images are not available.

bulletsZh: 数据门户搭建：主导跨业务线统一数据口径，将 40+ 分散看板收敛为 9 大专题 38 项核心看板，设计权限体系并搭建权限服务，全栈推进产品落地（独立完成前端开发/接口联调）；上线后覆盖部门 87% 成员（120+ 用户），周均使用 320+ 次，成为核心数据工具。
ChatBI 模块：对标瓴羊、网易有数等行业标杆，围绕问数/报告/解读三大场景设计 ChatBI 功能方案；主导数据源清洗与字段语义映射，支撑 RAG 语义召回准确率达 92%；上线后非技术人员取数占比提升至 70%，需求响应从 3 天压缩至实时。
碰撞事故自动化：对标 Tesla 输出安全策略调研，设计覆盖致因识别、责任判定等 23 项碰撞事故指标体系；协同技术团队完成数据架构方案，推动 AI 自动化碰撞数据标注落地，累计生成 380+ 份事故报告，效率提升 99.47%，用户满意度 96.9%。
C 端安全分产品：针对全量数据授权率偏低（62.54%）问题，从入口曝光、信息架构、交互引导三层系统优化触达与转化路径，同步优化安全评分体系的用户侧呈现；改版后授权率提升至 83.45%（+20.91pp），强化用户对小米汽车安全能力的认知心智。
bulletsEn: Data portal: unified definitions across business lines; consolidated 40+ dashboards into 9 themes and 38 core dashboards; designed permission system and service; drove end-to-end delivery (implemented frontend and API integration); adopted by 87% of the department (120+ users) with 320+ weekly uses.

ChatBI: benchmarked leading products; designed experiences for ask-data/report/interpretation; led data cleaning and semantic mapping for fields, achieving 92% RAG semantic retrieval accuracy; increased non-technical self-serve data access to 70% and reduced request response from 3 days to real-time.

Crash automation: benchmarked Tesla-style safety strategy; defined 23 crash metrics for cause identification and responsibility; co-designed data architecture and enabled AI-assisted crash data labeling; generated 380+ reports with 99.47% efficiency improvement and 96.9% satisfaction.

Consumer safety score: improved end-to-end consent and conversion for data authorization (baseline 62.54%) via exposure, information architecture, and guidance; refined user-facing safety scoring; increased authorization rate to 83.45% (+20.91pp) and strengthened safety perception.

items.deptZh: OPPO｜互联网部｜游戏增长业务
items.descZh: 业务介绍：聚焦平板端游戏体验短板，以键鼠映射功能为核心抓手，补齐与 PC 端操控精度差距，驱动游戏助手核心用户留存增长。
items.descEn: Scope: Improved tablet gaming experience via key-mouse mapping to close the control-precision gap vs. PC and grow retention for the game assistant’s core users.

productDetails.infoZh:
**1.什么是游戏助手？**

游戏助手是打造用户玩好游戏的一站式服务平台，满足用户在下载游戏后、玩游戏过程中的多样化诉求，提升用户游戏生命周期内的综合体验。

**2.怎样使用游戏助手？**

游戏助手是ColorOS平台针对游戏场景的独立侧边栏工具，在游戏中，通过侧边工具实现系统优化工具+游戏内容及福利的服务整合，为游戏用户提供游戏中闭环体验。

触发场景：游戏助手会在游戏场景下自动启动，在进入游戏页面时，弹出启动动画，动画结束后隐藏在屏幕左上方侧边栏（默认）；
productDetails.infoEn: OPPO's system-level game enhancement tool for tablets. It offers high-performance modes, key-mouse mapping, and AI-powered game assistance to improve control and immersion.

bulletsZh: 键鼠映射：整合 2000+ 条用户反馈与埋点数据交叉分析，定位误触率高、精准度低、多指协同难三大核心痛点；完成 4 款头部竞品功能对标，独立负责需求拆解与全链路交互逻辑设计；设计 20+ 核心埋点，构建用户行为数据反馈闭环，支撑后续迭代决策。
游戏助手体验：主导 AI 大神辅助模块新增 AI 能力，覆盖胜率预测、弹幕辅助、语音辅助三项核心能力，功能使用率提升 6.29%，深度使用率提升 3.87%；基于用户原声提炼需求，推动小游戏模块纳入游戏空间统一承载，上线后相关负面反馈降至近零。
成果反馈：键鼠映射上线后游戏助手 MAU 提升 1.83%（覆盖 50 万+ 用户），平板核心用户 3 日留存率提升 2.1%，操作类负面反馈减少 35%；助手体验（AI 大神辅助、游戏空间加入小游戏模块）优化落地后负面反馈率降低 73%，助手呼出率提升 1.78%。
bulletsEn: Key-mouse mapping: analyzed 2,000+ user feedback items alongside event data; identified three key issues (high mis-touch rate, low precision, difficult multi-finger coordination); benchmarked 4 leading competitors; owned requirement breakdown and end-to-end interaction design; designed 20+ key events to build a data feedback loop for iteration decisions.

Assistant experience: led AI helper enhancement across win-rate prediction, barrage assist, and voice assist; +6.29% feature usage and +3.87% deep usage; distilled needs from user voice and integrated mini-games into the unified game space, reducing related negative feedback to near zero.

Impact: mapping launch increased assistant MAU by 1.83% (500k+ users reached) and improved 3-day retention of tablet core users by 2.1%, with 35% fewer operation-related negatives; subsequent optimizations reduced negative feedback by 73% and increased assistant invocation rate by 1.78%.
